### Dependence Day
Author: Shawn McEvoy
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-july-4-2011.html
Passage: Hosea 12:6
Points:
- Independence and self-reliance frequently fail in our relationships, work, and spiritual walk.
- Modern cultural ideas of freedom have drifted from responsible living into unchecked self-indulgence.
- Political allegiances and external religiosity cannot provide ultimate salvation or soul restoration.
- God calls believers to return to Him through active love, justice, and continual reliance.
- True honor and spiritual lifting come when we humbly acknowledge our daily dependence on the Lord.
